About.heading: About
About.body: I'm a frontend engineer working on complex B2B products — where UI isn't just pretty; it has to be fast, maintainable, and ready to grow. With Feature-Sliced Design, micro-frontends, and a focus on performance, I build systems teams can extend without friction. I also work in AI-driven development: Generative UI, MCP tools, agentic workflows, and Vercel/OpenAI SDK integrations.
About.educationDetail: Computer Engineering — Technical University of Tabriz, 2022–2027

bulut.title: Senior Frontend Developer
bulut.summary: Enterprise ERP. Owner of Route Manager — an OptimoRoute-class logistics UI.
highlights: Cut Route Manager memory usage by 70% while scaling to ~94 routes and ~3,700 invoices — clustering, virtualized timelines, narrow Zustand subscriptions, and parallel OSRM.
Designed the Sale Platform Admin architecture with an Nx monorepo and Rspack Module Federation: independent deploys, shared packages, faster incremental builds.
Separated product surfaces with FSD and shared UI contracts so features ship without a props monolith.
Built the Customer Panel commerce flow (catalog, cart, orders) on TanStack Query with explicit cache and invalidation.
Standardized agentic AI development (Cursor/Claude skills and rules, plan-to-implement loops) so generated code stays aligned with FSD boundaries.
Built a company-wide icon pack with React component support.

freelance.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
freelance.summary: Frontend and web for client projects — idea to delivery.
highlights: Built a realtime melted-gold trading platform for the Tabriz gold bazaar — live pricing and trades over WebSocket, no page refresh.
Shipped a full Next.js e-commerce site: App Router, SSR/SSG product routes, catalog, cart, and checkout.
Developed investisor.com with an admin panel (CKEditor), SSG/SSR rendering, and Server Actions for forms and mutations.
Owned delivery end-to-end — from scoping to production-ready UI.

primeproperty.title: Senior Frontend Developer
primeproperty.summary: Istanbul real-estate agency — buying, selling, and property investment.
highlights: Built the public property platform in Next.js — page structure and data fetching for a large catalog.
SSG/SSR loads thousands of properties in seconds — pre-rendered listing and detail routes.
Added i18n so buyers and investors browse one catalog in multiple languages, without separate sites.
Owned frontend delivery for listing search and property detail pages.
